items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know a guy named Ben Gussick or Cusick or something? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, a drummer?

ctx.x: That's right, I mean, I. That's right. I mean, I. That's right. That's right. Eddie Wilson. Who, did they do, did you have arrangements in the band? Yeah, there was, somebody made arrangements for me. I don't know who he was, maybe, you know. I wish the dumb machine was kind of a fit for him.
Did you know a guy named Ben Gussick or Cusick or something?
